title: VS-Items
description: Plugin for custom items with mechanics
body:
## 🔵 DESCRIPTION
Plugin for custom items with mechanics.
## 🔵 FEATURES
- 12 Custom items
- Items are configurable
- Intuitive in-game configuration GUI
- Custom GUI layout configurable in files
- Custom messages configurable in files
- Support for **CustomModelData**
- Formatting support: **MiniMessage (Adventure API)**
## 🔵 PERMISSIONS
- **vs_items.admin** » Access to all plugin commands and features
- **vs_items.command.reload** » Access to the /items reload command
- **vs_items.command.settings** » Access to the /items settings command
- **vs_items.command.storage** » Access to the /items storage command
## 🔵 COMMANDS
- **/items reload** » Reloads the configuration without restarting the server
- **/items settings** » Opens a clear and user-friendly plugin settings GUI
- **/items storage** » Opens a GUI with items. When a player clicks an item, it is added to their inventory
## 🔵 BUG REPORTS
If you found a bug or need help with the configuration, join our Discord server.
